action_cap: strict cumulative per-model-turn cap, configured at launch with ARC3_ACTION_CAP=14; Python execution is interrupted immediately after the capped action and later action() calls in that turn cannot bypass it
preserved_world_model: persistent top-six curator with original per-input injection
composition: preserve Flash-Next force-fed ASCII animation v8 and production guarded same-context post-level reflection-v3, then add the proven v9 strict cumulative action-cap implementation; PLU is disabled
reflection_policy: after an engine-verified level win, run one short no-tool reflection in the same chat context, then reset completed-level rolling context and inject the canonical reflection once into the next-level input
reflection_schema: winning_world_model, decisive_evidence, minimal_recipe, redundant_actions, next_level_rule; redundancy is conservatively host-guarded against blanket prefixes, ranges, and more than three individually identified actions
temporal_detector: after exactly 5 prior actions in the game: changed_frames >= max(2, 2*rolling_median, median + max(1, ceil(3*1.4826*MAD))); prefer level action-family then level baseline when mature, otherwise fall back to game action-family or game baseline; window 32
local_region_detector: track 8-connected changed-cell components across adjacent transitions; keep components changing in at least 2 transitions; disconnected one-transition changes do not become animation regions, regardless of board location
spatial_gate: accept the existing large-motion gate or at least one persistent local region; no hard-coded HUD border exclusion
checkpoint_policy: terminal excluded; novel tails have 5-action cooldown and maximum 3 hard checkpoints per level; similar tails continue uninterrupted with a model-visible reminder
inspection_policy: for broad motion, automatically force-feed the v4-style compact storyboard using a motion-preserving 4x4-through-8x8 source block; for persistent local motion, also provide a description and keep up to 12 native local frames in RAM for an agent-selected absolute crop; never stretch aspect ratio or use blocks larger than 8x8
